# Sam Larcombe Tee

> MSci Physics student at the University of Cambridge (2022–present, First Class
> Honours 72% in the BA component). Interests: computational physics and fluid
> dynamics, scientific Python (numpy/scipy/matplotlib), Linux, Git/self-hosting,
> and STEM education and tutoring.

## Selected work

- [Where orderly flow becomes turbulence](https://samtee.uk/projects/flow/): research review on laminar-to-turbulent transition and CFD models
- [Encoding many spins, considering every bit](https://samtee.uk/projects/ising/): multi-spin encoding techniques for Ising models (memory use and performance)

## Teaching

- Freelance A-level tutor in physics, chemistry and mathematics since 2022
- STEM SMART mentor, Nov 2023–Apr 2024
